page.overview:
What is Flaaffy?

Flaaffy appears to a be a pink sheep that has white wool on its back to its chin along with black stripes on its ears and its tail. It also possesses a blue orb at the tip of its tail.

These Pokémon are usually mild-mannered and gentle.

If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

Flaaffy evolves from Mareep starting at level 15 and evolves into Ampharos starting at level 30.
